name: Rippling
description: Rippling is a workforce management platform that unifies HR, payroll, IT device/app management, and finance (spend management) on a single employee record, so changes like a new hire, promotion, or termination automatically sync across every connected module.
best_for: Growing companies that want to run HR, payroll, IT device management, and spend management from one system of record instead of stitching together separate point tools.
features: Unified employee record that syncs HR, payroll, benefits, and IT changes automatically across every connected module
Global payroll, contractor payments, Employer of Record (EOR), and Contractor of Record (CoR) for international teams
IT device and app management, including automated laptop provisioning/deprovisioning and identity and access management
Expense management, corporate cards, bill pay, and travel management through the Rippling Spend modules
Workflow Studio for building no-code custom automations and approval workflows on employee data
App Studio, a no-code tool for building custom internal applications on top of Rippling's employee data
Time & attendance, scheduling, performance management, and learning management modules
Analytics and reporting that span HR, IT, and finance data from the same underlying dataset
pros: Single employee record removes manual re-entry across HR, IT, and payroll when a change like a hire or termination happens
Highly modular: customers can start with one product, such as HRIS, and add Payroll, IT, or Spend management later
No-code Workflow Studio and App Studio let admins build automations and internal tools without engineering support
cons: Rippling's official pricing page does not list per-plan prices; every quote requires submitting company size and module selection to sales
Per-employee cost scales with each additional module (Payroll, IT, Spend, etc.), so the effective total price isn't visible until a quote is generated

alternatives.name: Gusto
alternatives.description: A payroll, benefits, and HR platform built for small and mid-sized businesses with transparent, published per-plan pricing.
alternatives.best_for: Small businesses wanting straightforward payroll and HR with published pricing rather than a custom platform quote.

alternatives.name: BambooHR
alternatives.description: A dedicated HRIS focused on core HR record-keeping, hiring, and employee experience for small and mid-sized businesses.
alternatives.best_for: Companies wanting a focused HRIS without also buying an IT or spend-management platform.

alternatives.name: Deel
alternatives.description: A global payroll and compliance platform specializing in hiring, paying, and managing international contractors and employees.
alternatives.best_for: Companies whose primary need is compliant global contractor and EOR payments rather than domestic IT/HR unification.

alternatives.name: ADP Workforce Now
alternatives.description: A long-established HCM suite from ADP covering payroll, benefits, and HR for small to enterprise employers.
alternatives.best_for: Employers wanting an established payroll provider with decades of tax-compliance infrastructure behind it.
